reviews.text: Our dog, Daithí has been coming to Collins Canine for a couple of years now and he loves it. He is well looked after and kept entertained. Thanks all!

My dog Millie absolutely loves it here. She is a very high energy 1 year old Golden Retriever and after a day here she is wiped out from a day of playing and becomes a sleeping lapdog.

The staff are great to deal and clearly love working with dogs.
Fantastic spot for my dog. They always give me back a happier, more balanced, chilled out pooch who's had fun with his buddy's for a few hours.

I just realized I never posted a review, shame on me!
My dog Rodger is a rescue and was terrified of people. We brought Rodger a few months after we got him and he immediately loved it!
Aidan and all the team are amazing and helped him a bunch. He absolutely LOVED going there!
Thank you so much for the great time Rodger spent with you. The only reason we don’t go anymore is because we left the country but we still speak about his time there often and miss it a lot!
Thank you again for your kidness and great work!
Couldnt recommend enough. Both for daycare and grooming… wouldn’t consider anyone else for out golden doodle

Contacted Aidan as saw he had mostly good reviews. Completely rude and unprofessional. Was told “he doesn’t take stressed or crazy dogs” and told to go elsewhere. When asked where would he recommend he said he didn’t know anywhere for me. I’ve heard before that he’s not a people person but didn’t believe it until I saw it. Wouldn’t recommend getting in touch with this guy.

Aidan, Rosin and Hilary are just amazing!  My little rescue is changing for the better every day, gaining confidence and learning how to play!  Aidan and team clearly adore the dogs and I know I'm leaving my one in safe hands - and the daily photo's are just the cherry on top!  Couldn't recommend enough!
